channel.title: Sound on Sound - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Sound on Sound (soundonsound.com)

item.title: BOOM Library release Seasons of Earth: European Autumn
item.description: boom_library_seasons_of_earth_european_autumn.jpg Made entirely from real natural recordings The latest release from BOOM Library comes packed with production-ready exterior ambiences that capture the distinct acoustic character of autumn.

item.title: Klang.io launch Transcription Studio
item.description: klangio_transcription_studio.jpeg Transcribe sheets, tabs or MIDI from audio files Transcription Studio can run as a DAW plug-in or standalone application, and promises to make it easier than ever for professional and hobbyist musicians alike to document and communicate even the most complex of musical ideas.

item.title: Warm Audio | SOS Podcast
item.description: bryce_young_warm_audio_header.jpg Behind The Brand Bryce Young, founder and president of Warm Audio discusses how the company began and how it quickly built a reputation for producing affordable studio gear inspired by classic vintage designs. Published March 2026 Music Business SOS PODCASTSAudio InterfacesMicrophones / MikingSignal Processors &gt; Compressors

item.title: ALM/Busy Circuits announce the Quaid Gigaslope &amp; FMco
item.description: alm_busy_circuits_quaid_gigaslope.jpg Latest Eurorack modules revealed ALM/Busy Circuits' range of Eurorack modules has just been expanded with a versatile new modulation tool and a compact FM synth voice.

item.title: Akai Pro unveil the MPC Sample
item.description: akai_pro_mpc_sample.jpg Smallest, most affordable MPC to date The MPC Sample draws its inspiration from the likes of the MPC60, and allows users to sample, chop and arrange beats anywhere with no computer required.

item.title: Two notes unveil the Captor X+
item.description: two_notes_captor_x_plus.jpg True Stereo DynIR Engine, Virtual Load Shaper & more The Captor X+ offers deeper control, enhanced stereo functionality and some new tone-shaping tools, all of which have been designed specifically for real valve amplifiers and modern silent stage/studio rigs.

item.title: The Crow Hill Company announce Crystal Pianos
item.description: the_crow_hill_company_crystal_pianos.jpg A piano with glass vessels for strings! Rather than faithfully capturing an acoustic instrument, The Crow Hill Company's latest release uses sampling to invent a completely new one.

item.title: SOS Music Creators Survey 2026
item.description: sos_quick_survey_2026_header_3.jpg We want to hear from you! Complete our survey and enter the prize draw for a chance to win one of three $50 Amazon vouchers!

item.title: FAC launch Bandit 2
item.description: fac_bandit_2.jpg New multi-band AUv3 plug-in announced FAC's multiband effects processor has just been treated to a major upgrade that introduces a new output limiter, enhanced linked controls and more.

item.title: Universal Audio’s Voice Of God now native
item.description: uad_little_labs_vog_0.jpg Little Labs emulation now available to all The latest Universal Audio plug-in to become available outside of the company’s DSP-powered UAD2 platform has just been announced, making yet another of their acclaimed processors available to all.

item.title: Pulsar-23: 1984 from SOMA Laboratory
item.description: soma_pulsar-23.jpg Just 84 units to be released in the US SOMA Laboratories have revealed an upcoming special-edition version of their Pulsar-23 unit that’s been created in collaboration with The Midium and the SOMA US division.

item.title: Electro-Harmonix release EHX Classics Bundle
item.description: electro-harmonix_ehx_classics_bundle.jpg Iconic guitar pedals now available in plug-in form Guitar effects experts Electro-Harmonix have teamed up with MixWave to turn a collection of their most prized pedals into plug-ins.

item.title: ESSENCE RS from Aim Audio
item.description: aim_audio_essence_rs.jpg "Remote Streaming Studio Condenser" Aim Audio's latest creation becomes the world’s first and only pro-grade microphone that doubles up as a fully functioning TV remote.

item.title: VEMIA Auction incoming
item.description: vemia_sos_header_image.jpg 4 – 11 April 2026 VEMIA’s latest gear auction is just around the corner, and there’s already a wealth of sought-after instruments and studio gear listed.

item.title: Iconic Instruments release Model 350 Tube Preamp
item.description: iconic_instruments_model_350_tube_preamp.jpg Emulates the input section of an Ampex 350 One of the latest arrivals to the Iconic Instruments range delivers a new tube preamp plug-in inspired by the circuitry employed in the Ampex 350 tape machine.
